senses.en: the two together

ex.en: Both answers are possible.
ex.zh: 两个答案都有可能。

ex.en: A city needs both affordable housing and good schools if it wants families to stay.
ex.zh: 如果一座城市希望家庭留下来，就既需要付得起的住房，也需要好学校。

tip: both...and... 连接并列成分，谓语用复数。

senses.en: worth a lot of money or very useful

ex.en: The old map is valuable.
ex.zh: 这张旧地图很有价值。

ex.en: A valuable seat on the late bus is the one a tired student can actually use.
ex.zh: 晚班车上有价值的座位，是疲惫的学生真正能用的那个。

tip: value 已在本库。valuable 是形容词。

senses.en: around a place

ex.en: The surrounding streets flood first.
ex.zh: 周围的街道最先进水。

ex.en: The surrounding hills keep the wind off the yard and also block the late sun.
ex.zh: 周围的山挡住了院子的风，也挡住了傍晚的太阳。

tip: 名词环境常用复数 surroundings。动词是 surround。

senses.en: medical surgery, or the way something works

ex.en: The operation was successful.
ex.zh: 手术成功了。

ex.en: The operation of a night bus depends on drivers, fuel, and a timetable people trust.
ex.zh: 夜班公交的运转取决于司机、燃料，以及人们信任的时刻表。

tip: operation 可指手术或运转，要看语境。

senses.en: to believe someone is honest or reliable
belief that someone is reliable

ex.en: I trust her to lock the lab.
ex.zh: 我信任她会锁好实验室。

ex.en: People trust a clinic more when the same nurse is there every week.
ex.zh: 当同一位护士每周都在时，人们更信任一家诊所。

col: trust sb to do｜相信某人会做
tip: trust 后可接 sb to do。

senses.en: a period of time used for an activity

ex.en: The next session starts at two.
ex.zh: 下一节两点开始。

ex.en: A short session every day beats one long session that nobody can finish.
ex.zh: 每天一小节，胜过谁也完成不了的一长节。

tip: session 可指一节课、一次会议或一段时间。

senses.en: in the inner part of
in the inner part

ex.en: Please wait inside the hall.
ex.zh: 请在大厅里面等。

ex.en: Noise from inside a factory can be lower than the noise of trucks waiting outside it.
ex.zh: 工厂内部的噪音，可能低于在外面等候的卡车的噪音。

tip: inside 可作介词或副词。

senses.en: a wide street, often with trees

ex.en: The library is on the next avenue.
ex.zh: 图书馆在下一条大街上。

ex.en: An avenue of trees cools the walk to school.
ex.zh: 大街两旁的树让上学的路凉快一些。

tip: avenue 可数。比喻“途径”时说 an avenue to。

senses.en: needed

ex.en: A pencil is necessary for the drawing test.
ex.zh: 绘画测验必须带铅笔。

ex.en: It is necessary to tell students why a rule exists, not only what they must not do.
ex.zh: 有必要告诉学生一条规则为什么存在，而不只是不准做什么。

tip: 常用 It is necessary to do，不说 somebody is necessary to do。

senses.en: one circuit of a track, or the top of the legs when sitting

ex.en: She ran one more lap.
ex.zh: 她又跑了一圈。

ex.en: A child on a parent's lap still needs a seat belt in the taxi.
ex.zh: 坐在家长膝上的孩子，在出租车里仍然需要安全带。

tip: lap 也可作动词“拍打”，如波浪。本条以一圈和膝部为主。

senses.en: to put forward an idea

ex.en: I suggest leaving ten minutes early.
ex.zh: 我建议早走十分钟。

ex.en: Reports suggest that later school starts can improve attention in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 报告提出，上学时间晚一点可能提高第一节课的注意力。

tip: suggest 后接 doing 或 that 从句，不接 to do。从句里常用 should 或动词原形。

senses.en: untidy

ex.en: The desk is messy after the art class.
ex.zh: 美术课之后书桌很乱。

ex.en: A messy page is hard to mark, so leave a margin and keep the lines straight.
ex.zh: 页面凌乱就难批改，所以留出页边，把行写直。

tip: messy 形容又乱又脏。名词 mess。整洁是 neat 或 tidy。

senses.en: to choose officially
a choice made in an election

ex.en: The class will vote for a monitor.
ex.zh: 班级将投票选班长。

ex.en: People vote more calmly when the polling place is near and the rules are posted in plain words.
ex.zh: 当投票点很近、规则用浅显的话贴出来时，人们投票会更从容。

tip: vote 作名词是“选票”或“投票”。

senses.en: a journey, often a short one

ex.en: Our class trip is to the history museum.
ex.zh: 我们班的旅行是去历史博物馆。

ex.en: A school trip teaches more when students write what they saw, not only where they went.
ex.zh: 如果学生写下看到了什么，而不只是去了哪里，学校旅行就教得更多。

tip: trip 常指较短或有目的的出行。动词 trip 是绊倒。

senses.en: a person who drives a vehicle

ex.en: The bus driver waited for the last student.
ex.zh: 公交司机等了最后一名学生。

ex.en: A tired driver on a school route is a reason to limit hours, not only to print a slogan.
ex.zh: 校车路线上疲劳的司机，是限制工时的理由，而不只是印一句口号。

tip: 动词开车是 drive，已在本库。

senses.en: related to music
a play with songs

ex.en: The musical evening is on Friday.
ex.zh: 音乐晚会在周五。

ex.en: A musical instrument that students can borrow matters more than a poster of a star.
ex.zh: 学生能借到的乐器，比一张明星海报更重要。

tip: musical 作名词是音乐剧。music 已在本库。

senses.en: to move quickly from side to side

ex.en: Shake the bottle before you open it.
ex.zh: 打开前先摇瓶子。

ex.en: Do not shake a labelled bottle in the lab.
ex.zh: 不要在实验室里摇一个贴了标签的瓶子。

tip: 过去式 shook，过去分词 shaken。本条不写如何混合危险液体。

senses.en: to stop being angry with someone

ex.en: Please forgive the delay.
ex.zh: 请原谅这次延误。

ex.en: A school can forgive a late form and still write the rule.
ex.zh: 学校可以原谅迟交的表格，同时仍然把规定写下来。

tip: 过去式 forgave，过去分词 forgiven。

senses.en: a vehicle that can fly

ex.en: No aircraft landed during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间没有飞机降落。

ex.en: An aircraft over a school is a noise problem even when the lesson is about flight.
ex.zh: 即使课上讲的是飞行，学校上空的飞机也是噪音问题。

tip: aircraft 单复数同形。不说 aircrafts。

senses.en: a person who operates a machine or a phone service

ex.en: The operator checked the machine.
ex.zh: 操作员检查了机器。

ex.en: A night operator needs the late bus as much as a student does.
ex.zh: 上夜班的操作员需要晚班车，和学生一样。

tip: 动词 operate 已在本库。

senses.en: bags that you take on a journey

ex.en: Baggage must be labelled with your name.
ex.zh: 行李必须贴上你的名字。

ex.en: His baggage missed the connection, but the small bag of books stayed with him.
ex.zh: 他的行李没赶上换乘，装书的小包还在他身边。

tip: baggage 不可数，与 luggage 同义。行李提取处是 baggage claim。一件仍说 a piece of baggage。

senses.en: willing to give
larger or more plentiful than usual or expected

ex.en: She is generous with her time.
ex.zh: 她在时间上很大方。

ex.en: Generous donations from local businesses can help community centres provide affordable activities for children and older residents.
ex.zh: 当地企业的慷慨捐助可以帮助社区中心为儿童和老年居民提供价格实惠的活动。

col: generous with your time｜不吝惜时间
tip: be generous with sth表示在某方面慷慨。

senses.en: to use rude words, or to promise formally

ex.en: Do not swear at a classmate.
ex.zh: 不要咒骂同学。

ex.en: Witnesses swear to tell what they saw, not what they fear.
ex.zh: 证人发誓讲他们看见的，而不是他们害怕的。

tip: swear 的过去式是 swore，过去分词是 sworn。本条不列举骂人的话。

senses.en: a piece of furniture for sleeping

ex.en: I went to bed at ten.
ex.zh: 我十点上床睡觉。

ex.en: A student who goes to bed after midnight will feel the cost in the first lesson.
ex.zh: 午夜后才上床的学生，会在第一节课感受到代价。

tip: go to bed 指去睡觉；sleep 是睡觉这个动作。

senses.en: a large amount of water covering land
to cover with water

ex.en: The flood reached the school gate.
ex.zh: 洪水到了校门口。

ex.en: A flood plan should name who calls parents.
ex.zh: 防汛方案应当写明谁给家长打电话。

tip: flood 作动词是淹没。

senses.en: television

ex.en: We watched the news on TV.
ex.zh: 我们在电视上看了新闻。

ex.en: TV can warn a town about a storm, but only if people still have electricity.
ex.zh: 电视可以警告城镇有风暴，但前提是人们还有电。

tip: TV 是 television 的缩写，前面常用 on。

senses.en: a wild animal with a bushy tail

ex.en: A fox crossed the path at dusk.
ex.zh: 黄昏时一只狐狸穿过小路。

ex.en: Stories use the fox as a clever character, which is not a reason to feed one near school.
ex.zh: 故事把狐狸写成聪明的角色，这不是在学校附近喂它的理由。

tip: fox 可数。复数是 foxes。

senses.en: having the usual qualities of a type

ex.en: This is a typical Monday: the bus is full.
ex.zh: 这是典型的周一：公交是满的。

ex.en: A typical lunch in the canteen should be one a student can actually afford.
ex.zh: 食堂里典型的午餐，应当是学生真正买得起的。

tip: be typical of 表示是某类人或事物的典型。

senses.en: not different

ex.en: We took the same bus home.
ex.zh: 我们乘了同一班车回家。

ex.en: Two schools can follow the same timetable and still offer very different support to struggling students.
ex.zh: 两所学校可以执行同样的课表，但对学习吃力的学生提供的帮助仍然很不一样。

tip: same 前面通常加 the。

senses.en: to make something stronger

ex.en: These exercises strengthen the muscles you use for jumping.
ex.zh: 这些练习增强你跳跃时用到的肌肉。

ex.en: The school will strengthen the bridge between the two buildings before the rainy season.
ex.zh: 雨季前学校会加固两栋楼之间的桥。

tip: strengthen 是动词。名词 strength，形容词 strong。

senses.en: the state of not having a job

ex.en: Unemployment rose after the factory closed.
ex.zh: 工厂关闭后，失业人数上升了。

ex.en: Unemployment figures should name the town, not only a national average.
ex.zh: 失业数字应当写出城镇，而不只是全国平均数。

tip: unemployment 通常不可数。

senses.en: to think something will happen

ex.en: I expect the bus at eight.
ex.zh: 我预计公交八点到。

ex.en: Parents expect a safe walk to school, not only a high score at the end of the year.
ex.zh: 家长期待的是安全的上学路，而不只是年底的高分。

col: expect sb to do｜期望某人做
tip: expect 后接 to do 或 sb to do，不接 doing。

senses.en: the feeling of a place; air around Earth
the mixture of gases surrounding a planet

ex.en: The classroom had a friendly atmosphere.
ex.zh: 教室里气氛友好。

ex.en: A supportive classroom atmosphere encourages students to ask questions and participate more actively in discussions.
ex.zh: 相互支持的课堂氛围鼓励学生提问，并更加积极地参与讨论。

tip: 表示某种氛围常用an atmosphere；地球大气用the atmosphere。

senses.en: a quick look, or an image made by scanning
to look quickly or to copy with a scanner

ex.en: Scan the page for dates before you read every line.
ex.zh: 逐行读之前，先扫一遍这一页里的日期。

ex.en: The library will scan the old photos if you bring them on a Thursday.
ex.zh: 如果你星期四把老照片带来，图书馆可以扫描。

tip: scan 可以是快速浏览，也可以是机器扫描。

senses.en: a recording of moving pictures

ex.en: We watched a short video about the river.
ex.zh: 我们看了一段关于这条河的短视频。

ex.en: A video can spread a false claim widely before anyone has time to check the pictures.
ex.zh: 一段视频可以在任何人来得及核对画面之前，把一个虚假说法传得很广。

tip: video 可数。看视频用 watch a video。

senses.en: a hard part of the body

ex.en: The model shows one bone of the arm.
ex.zh: 模型展示手臂的一根骨头。

ex.en: A broken bone is a reason to call an adult, not to finish the match.
ex.zh: 骨折是叫成年人的理由，不是把比赛打完。

tip: bone 可数。bones 可指骨骼。

senses.en: to mark a surface with something sharp, or to rub skin
a thin mark

ex.en: The cat may scratch the chair.
ex.zh: 猫可能会抓椅子。

ex.en: Do not scratch the lab bench with the glass.
ex.zh: 不要用玻璃划实验台。

tip: scratch 也可作名词。本条不写如何伤人。

senses.en: throughout a period of time

ex.en: Please do not talk during the exam.
ex.zh: 考试期间请不要说话。

ex.en: During a drought, schools can show families how small daily changes save a surprising amount of water.
ex.zh: 干旱期间，学校可以向家庭展示，日常的小改变能省下惊人的水量。

tip: during 后接名词，不接句子；接句子用 while 或 when。

senses.en: a glass that shows a reflection

ex.en: There is a mirror by the bathroom door.
ex.zh: 卫生间门边有一面镜子。

ex.en: A mirror in the hall does not tell you whether the bus is late.
ex.zh: 大厅里的镜子不会告诉你公交是否晚点。

tip: mirror 作动词是反映。

senses.en: a skill, exam, or certificate that fits you for a job

ex.en: The job asks for a teaching qualification.
ex.zh: 这份工作要求有教师资格。

ex.en: She listed every qualification on the form, including the first-aid course from last spring.
ex.zh: 她在表上列出每项资格，包括去年春天的急救课。

tip: 资格、文凭都可以是 qualification。动词是 qualify。

senses.en: a place for young children, or where plants are grown

ex.en: The nursery opens at half past seven.
ex.zh: 托儿所七点半开门。

ex.en: Behind the nursery for children there is a plant nursery that sells young trees in spring.
ex.zh: 幼儿园后面有一个苗圃，春天卖小树。

tip: nursery 可以是托儿所，也可以是育苗的苗圃。看后面是 children 还是 plants。

senses.en: clear enough to see through

ex.en: The box is transparent, so you can see the pins.
ex.zh: 盒子是透明的，能看见里面的大头针。

ex.en: The guards asked for a transparent bag so they could see what students brought in.
ex.zh: 警卫要求用透明袋，这样能看见学生带进来的东西。

tip: 能看穿的用 transparent。说过程公开、不隐瞒，也可以用这个词。

senses.en: very serious, or starting suddenly

ex.en: The doctor called the pain acute and sent him for a check.
ex.zh: 医生说这是急性疼痛，让他去做检查。

ex.en: An acute shortage of clean water, not a slow leak, closed the dorm kitchens.
ex.zh: 宿舍厨房关掉，是因为洁净水严重短缺，不是因为慢慢漏水。

tip: 参考表是「十分严重的，（病）急性的」。acute angle 是锐角，本卡先记严重和急性。

senses.en: to let liquid or gas escape
a hole that lets something escape

ex.en: The bottle leaked in my bag and soaked the notes.
ex.zh: 瓶子在书包里漏了，笔记湿透了。

ex.en: A leak in the roof dripped onto the piano all night, so the concert moved.
ex.zh: 屋顶的漏洞滴了一整夜，落在钢琴上，音乐会只好改地方。

tip: leak 可指液体、气体，也可指消息走漏。

senses.en: to choose someone by voting

ex.en: Our class will elect a monitor on Monday.
ex.zh: 我们班星期一选举班长。

ex.en: The club elected her captain because she had kept every practice record this term.
ex.zh: 社团选她当队长，因为她这学期记下了每次训练。

tip: elect 是投票选出。electric 是电的，已在词库，不是同一个词。

senses.en: not boastful; not large
not large in size, amount, or cost
wearing clothes that do not reveal much of the body

ex.en: She is modest about her success.
ex.zh: 她对自己的成功很谦虚。

ex.en: Even a modest increase in public transport funding could improve services in rural communities.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通拨款只小幅增加，也可能改善农村社区的服务。

col: modest about one's achievements｜对自己的成就谦虚
tip: 形容人常指谦虚；形容数量常指不大。

senses.en: a political theory that calls for common ownership of the means of production

ex.en: The history unit introduces communism in one chapter.
ex.zh: 历史单元用一章介绍共产主义。

ex.en: The textbook defines communism and then asks students to compare it with other ideas they have met.
ex.zh: 课本给共产主义下了定义，再让学生把它和已经见过的其他思想作比较。

col: the theory of communism｜共产主义理论
under communism｜在共产主义制度下
tip: 名词 communism，形容词和指人的名词都是 communist。历史课按课本定义理解，不把口号当释义。

senses.en: either of the two bones that hold the teeth

ex.en: He rubbed his jaw after the dentist finished.
ex.zh: 牙医做完后，他揉了揉下巴。

ex.en: A tight jaw can worsen a headache, so the coach told him to drop his shoulders.
ex.zh: 下巴绷着会让头疼更厉害，教练让他把肩膀放松。

tip: 下巴和颌都是 jaw。下巴上的酒窝不是 jaw。

senses.en: facts that prove something
To show clearly that something exists or is true.

ex.en: There is no evidence of cheating.
ex.zh: 没有作弊的证据。

ex.en: Governments should consider scientific evidence before introducing policies intended to improve public health outcomes.
ex.zh: 政府在推出旨在改善公共健康状况的政策前，应考虑科学证据。

tip: 作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。

senses.en: clothes worn next to the skin under other clothes

ex.en: Pack clean underwear for the three-day trip.
ex.zh: 三天的出行要带上干净内衣。

ex.en: The lost-property box had a scarf and a pair of gloves, but no underwear.
ex.zh: 失物箱里有围巾和一副手套，没有内衣。

col: a change of underwear｜一套换洗内衣
tip: underwear 通常不可数。一套可以说 a pair 只在有些搭配里，更稳妥是 some underwear。

senses.en: to allow something you do not like, or to bear it

ex.en: I cannot tolerate noise during a quiz.
ex.zh: 测验时我受不了噪音。

ex.en: The lab will not tolerate food near the chemicals, even if the packet stays closed.
ex.zh: 即使袋子是封着的，实验室也不允许食物靠近化学品。

tip: tolerate 后面接名词或 doing，不接 to do。名词 tolerance，形容词 tolerant。

senses.en: a place a bird makes to hold its eggs

ex.en: There is a nest in the pine behind the lab.
ex.zh: 实验室后面的松树上有一个鸟巢。

ex.en: The nest fell in the wind, and we left the chicks for the parent bird to find.
ex.zh: 鸟巢被风吹掉了，我们把雏鸟留在原地，让亲鸟来找。

tip: nest 是巢。不要和 next 看混。

senses.en: a way of dealing with something
To move nearer to someone or something.
To begin dealing with something or contact someone about it.

ex.en: A new approach may solve the problem.
ex.zh: 新方法可能解决这个问题。

ex.en: A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
ex.zh: 均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。

col: an approach to learning｜学习方法
adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
approach a problem｜着手处理问题
approach someone for advice｜找某人征求建议
tip: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

senses.en: towards a higher place or level

ex.en: Count upwards from twenty to thirty.
ex.zh: 从二十往上数到三十。

ex.en: The path runs upwards through pine trees and comes out above the morning cloud.
ex.zh: 这条路向上穿过松林，走到晨雾上面。

tip: 英式副词常用 upwards。形容词 upward 本库另列。upwards of 100 表示一百多。
note: 副词 upwards。同批的 upward 主要作形容词，不合并。

senses.en: a person who pays tax to the government

ex.en: Each taxpayer received a paper receipt.
ex.zh: 每位纳税人都拿到一张纸质收据。

ex.en: The hall explained how a taxpayer can check the school budget before the town votes on it.
ex.zh: 礼堂里讲了纳税人怎样在镇上投票前核对学校预算。

tip: taxpayer 是交税的人。动词是 pay tax。钱的用法常说 taxpayers' money。

senses.en: about right and wrong
a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story

ex.en: The story has a moral lesson.
ex.zh: 这个故事有道德寓意。

ex.en: Companies have a moral responsibility to ensure that their suppliers provide safe working conditions.
ex.zh: 企业在道义上有责任确保其供应商提供安全的工作环境。

col: the moral of the story｜故事的寓意
tip: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: an animal with horns, kept for milk or meat

ex.en: A goat stood by the fence on the farm visit.
ex.zh: 参观农场时，一只山羊站在篱笆边。

ex.en: The goat chewed the notice that had been tied to the post, so we wrote it again.
ex.zh: 山羊把系在柱子上的通知嚼了，于是我们又写了一张。

tip: goat 是山羊。绵羊是 sheep。

senses.en: shaped like an egg

ex.en: The mirror in the hall is oval.
ex.zh: 走廊里的镜子是椭圆形的。

ex.en: Draw an oval around the right name, then write one reason under the picture.
ex.zh: 在正确的名字外画一个椭圆，再在图下写一条理由。

tip: oval 多作形容词。作名词时就是那个椭圆。

senses.en: in the sea, not far from the coast

ex.en: An offshore wind farm is planned.
ex.zh: 计划建一座近海风电场。

ex.en: Fishermen say the offshore water is rougher than the bay, so small boats stay in.
ex.zh: 渔民说近海比海湾更颠，小船就留在湾里。

tip: offshore 相对海岸而言，在海里不远的地方。岸上是 onshore。

senses.en: to look at a book for information, or to ask an expert

ex.en: Consult the dictionary before you guess.
ex.zh: 先查词典，再猜。

ex.en: We consult the nurse when a player is hurt, rather than deciding the treatment ourselves.
ex.zh: 队员受伤时我们请教护士，而不是自己决定怎么处理。

tip: 查词典是 consult a dictionary。请教某人是 consult sb。

senses.en: an amount left over after what is needed

ex.en: The farm sold its surplus of rice.
ex.zh: 农场卖掉了多余的大米。

ex.en: A surplus of chairs let every visitor sit, which had not happened at the last meeting.
ex.zh: 椅子有富余，每位来宾都能坐，上次开会并没有这样。

tip: surplus 是多出来的部分。不够是 shortage。贸易顺差是 trade surplus。

senses.en: a short look at something before it is shown or studied
to look at or show something in advance

ex.en: We watched a short preview of the play.
ex.zh: 我们看了这出戏的一小段预告。

ex.en: Read the preview at the start of the chapter before you answer the five questions.
ex.zh: 回答那五个问题之前，先读本章开头的预习部分。

tip: preview 既可以是预告片，也可以是上课前的预习。

senses.en: based on personal feeling rather than facts

ex.en: Taste is subjective, facts are not.
ex.zh: 口味是主观的，事实不是。

ex.en: A subjective comment about the painting is welcome, if you also describe what you see.
ex.zh: 关于这幅画的主观评论可以有，但你也要写出自己看见了什么。

tip: subjective 对 objective。判断题里「主观题」有时说 a subjective question，和这个词的哲学义相关。

senses.en: a list of goods or books, British spelling

ex.en: She ordered seeds from a garden catalogue.
ex.zh: 她照着一本园艺目录订了种子。

ex.en: The spring catalogue shows boots and coats, with the price printed beside each drawing.
ex.zh: 春季目录上有靴子和外套，每幅图旁边印着价格。

tip: 英式拼作 catalogue。美式 catalog 在本批另列，不要并成一条。
note: 英式拼写。美式 catalog 在本批另列。

senses.en: making you feel worried or upset

ex.en: The ending of the film was disturbing.
ex.zh: 这部电影的结尾令人不安。

ex.en: A disturbing noise from the lab made the teacher stop the class and check the gas.
ex.zh: 实验室里一阵令人不安的声音让老师停下课，去检查煤气。

col: a disturbing result｜令人不安的结果
find sth disturbing｜觉得某事不安
tip: disturbing 形容事物让人不安。感到不安的人用 disturbed。动词是 disturb。

senses.en: to carry out; to lead
to allow heat or electricity to pass through
the way a person behaves, especially towards others

ex.en: Scientists conduct experiments in the lab.
ex.zh: 科学家在实验室进行实验。

ex.en: Researchers should conduct thorough trials before recommending new treatments for widespread use in public hospitals.
ex.zh: 研究人员在建议公立医院广泛采用新疗法之前，应开展充分的试验。

tip: 动词重音在后；名词重音在前，英音/ˈkɒndʌkt/。

senses.en: hurt feelings, or an illegal act

ex.en: He meant no offence by the joke.
ex.zh: 他开那个玩笑并无冒犯之意。

ex.en: The letter called the remark an offence to the team and asked for a public apology.
ex.zh: 信里说那句话冒犯了全队，并要求公开道歉。

tip: 英式拼作 offence。美式常作 offense。take offence 是生气。
note: 英式拼写。美式 offense 不在本库。

senses.en: wrong about a fact

ex.en: I was mistaken about the room number.
ex.zh: 我把房间号弄错了。

ex.en: If the date is mistaken, correct it before the office locks the form away.
ex.zh: 日期如果错了，要在办公室把表锁起来之前改掉。

tip: be mistaken about sth。人错了用 mistaken，不要说 I am mistake。

senses.en: the lightest chemical element, a gas

ex.en: Hydrogen is the lightest gas on this chart.
ex.zh: 这张表上最轻的气体是氢。

ex.en: The teacher showed that hydrogen burns, then said we must not light the tube ourselves.
ex.zh: 老师演示了氢会燃烧，接着说管子不能由我们自己去点。

tip: 化学符号 H。它是气体，不是金属。实验只看老师做。

senses.en: to discuss opposing views
To discuss a subject by considering different views.
To think carefully about options before making a decision.

ex.en: Students will debate the topic in class.
ex.zh: 学生们将在课堂上辩论这个话题。

ex.en: The debate over free public transport centres on its environmental benefits and the cost to taxpayers.
ex.zh: 关于免费公共交通的争论集中在其环境效益和纳税人需要承担的费用上。

col: debate an issue｜讨论一个问题
tip: 动词可直接接议题；debate whether to表示权衡。

senses.en: on purpose

ex.en: He deliberately left the last question blank.
ex.zh: 他故意把最后一题空着。

ex.en: She deliberately spoke slowly so the visitors could write down the room numbers.
ex.zh: 她故意说得很慢，好让来访者记下房间号。

tip: deliberately 是有意，不是碰巧。反义常常是 by accident。

senses.en: helpful

ex.en: Walking is beneficial to health.
ex.zh: 散步有益健康。

ex.en: Access to green spaces is particularly beneficial to urban residents who have limited opportunities for outdoor exercise.
ex.zh: 对于户外锻炼机会有限的城市居民来说，能够使用绿地尤其有益。

tip: 常接to或for，说明对谁或哪方面有益。

senses.en: enough, or more than enough

ex.en: There is ample time to check the sum.
ex.zh: 有足够的时间核对总数。

ex.en: Ample seats remained after the first class sat down, so the visitors did not stand.
ex.zh: 第一个班坐下以后座位还很宽裕，来宾不用站着。

tip: ample 比 enough 更强调充裕。abundant 本库另有一条，常形容自然供给。

senses.en: a tree with needles that stay green

ex.en: A pine stands behind the science building.
ex.zh: 科学楼后面有一棵松树。

ex.en: Needles from the pine covered the path, and they stuck to our wet shoes.
ex.zh: 松针铺满了小路，还粘在我们湿鞋子上。

tip: 参考表这一行是名词「松树」。动词 pine for 表示苦苦思念，不是本卡的义项。

senses.en: a line that marks a limit
A limit defining acceptable behaviour or the scope of something

ex.en: Respect personal boundary at work.
ex.zh: 在工作中尊重个人界限。

ex.en: Clear boundaries between work and personal life can protect employees' mental health and reduce long-term stress.
ex.zh: 明确工作与个人生活的界限，可以保护员工的心理健康并减轻长期压力。

tip: boundary 强调分界；border 常用于国家或地区边界。

senses.en: a measurement of length, width, or height, or an aspect

ex.en: Length is only one dimension of the box.
ex.zh: 长度只是这个盒子的一个尺寸。

ex.en: The drawing needs a third dimension, depth, or the cupboard will not fit against the wall.
ex.zh: 这张图需要第三个维度，也就是深度，否则柜子靠不上墙。

tip: 参考表写量度、尺寸、面积、程度、范围。画图和说方面都可以用 dimension。

senses.en: to send people away, or to refuse to consider an idea

ex.en: The coach did not dismiss the error.
ex.zh: 教练没有把这个失误放过去。

ex.en: They will not dismiss anyone who missed the bus, but the office must record the late arrival.
ex.zh: 他们不会因为有人误了班车就解雇谁，办公室必须记下迟到。

col: dismiss an idea｜对某想法不予考虑
tip: class is dismissed 是下课。dismiss sb from a job 是解雇。形容词 dismissive 是不屑的。

senses.en: tasting of salt, or containing salt

ex.en: The soup is salty enough already.
ex.zh: 汤已经够咸了。

ex.en: Salty snacks make you thirsty, so the canteen puts water beside them.
ex.zh: 咸的零食会让人渴，食堂就在旁边放了水。

tip: salty 是咸。淡而无味是 bland，甜是 sweet。盐本身是 salt。

senses.en: a situation in which you must choose between two difficult options

ex.en: The dilemma is time versus safety.
ex.zh: 这个两难是时间对安全。

ex.en: She faced a dilemma: tell the teacher now, or wait until she had the whole story.
ex.zh: 她面临两难：现在就告诉老师，还是等自己把事情弄完整再讲。

col: a moral dilemma｜道德上的两难
tip: dilemma 是两边都难的选择。只是一个难题不一定是 dilemma。复数 dilemmas。

senses.en: meant to be kept secret

ex.en: The report is confidential until Friday.
ex.zh: 这份报告在周五之前是机密的。

ex.en: Please keep the names confidential, and do not read them aloud in a full classroom.
ex.zh: 请把姓名保密，不要在坐满人的教室里念出来。

tip: confidential 比 secret 更常用于文件和公务。副词 confidentially。

senses.en: a calm, serious quality that deserves respect

ex.en: Speak to the guest with dignity, even if you are nervous.
ex.zh: 即使紧张，也要有尊严地跟客人说话。

ex.en: The team lost, but they left the court with dignity and shook hands.
ex.zh: 队伍输了，但他们体面地离开球场，并握了手。

tip: dignity 不可数时指尊严。a dignity 不常见。

senses.en: to judge how good or useful something is

ex.en: We evaluate sources before we quote them.
ex.zh: 引用之前我们先评估资料。

ex.en: The teacher will evaluate the projects on Friday and return a short written note.
ex.zh: 老师星期五评估这些项目，并退回一则简短的书面意见。

tip: evaluate 和 assess 接近。名词 evaluation。

senses.en: a violent storm with a circular wind

ex.en: The hurricane warning kept the boats in the harbor.
ex.zh: 飓风警报让船只留在港里。

ex.en: After the hurricane, students helped clear branches from the road to school.
ex.zh: 飓风过后，学生们帮忙清开通往学校的路上的树枝。

tip: 参考表写「飓风，十二级风」。英式也常读成带 /eɪ/ 的 hurricane，本卡采用表里的 /ˈhʌrɪkən/。

senses.en: to try
To try to do something, especially something difficult.

ex.en: She will attempt to climb the mountain.
ex.zh: 她将尝试爬山。

ex.en: Many cities are attempting to reduce air pollution by improving public transport and expanding cycling networks.
ex.zh: 许多城市正通过改善公共交通和扩展自行车道网络来尝试减少空气污染。

col: attempt to do something｜尝试做某事
in an attempt to｜为了尝试
tip: 动词后接to do；名词常用an attempt at doing。

senses.en: stiff, or not willing to bend rules or opinions

ex.en: The board is rigid and will not bend.
ex.zh: 这块板是硬的，弯不了。

ex.en: A rigid timetable helps some students, and it traps others who need a longer lab.
ex.zh: 死板的时间表帮得了部分学生，也会困住需要更长实验时间的人。

tip: rigid 可以是材料硬，也可以是规矩不肯通融。反义 flexible。

senses.en: worried; eager
Very eager to do something or for something to happen.

ex.en: She felt anxious before the test.
ex.zh: 考试前她感到焦虑。

ex.en: Students may become anxious about their future when career guidance is unavailable at school.
ex.zh: 学校不提供职业指导时，学生可能会对未来感到焦虑。

tip: anxious about表担忧；anxious to do常表急切。

senses.en: a light silver metal

ex.en: Aluminium cans go into the blue bin.
ex.zh: 铝罐放进蓝色回收箱。

ex.en: The frame is aluminium, so it is light enough for one person to carry upstairs.
ex.zh: 框架是铝的，轻得一个人就能扛上楼。

tip: 英式拼写 aluminium，五个音节。美式 aluminum 少一个 i，不在本库，不另开词头。
note: 英式 aluminium。美式 aluminum 不是本考纲这条词头。

senses.en: a hand with the fingers closed tightly

ex.en: He knocked on the door with his fist.
ex.zh: 他用拳头敲门。

ex.en: She opened her fist and showed the key she had been holding through the whole speech.
ex.zh: 她张开拳头，露出演讲全程一直握着的那把钥匙。

tip: 拳头是 fist。首先是 first。只差一个字母。

senses.en: to pay someone for a loss, or to balance a weakness

ex.en: The shop will compensate her for the broken lamp.
ex.zh: 商店会赔偿她打碎的灯。

ex.en: Extra practice can compensate for a slow start, if you keep the same plan every week.
ex.zh: 要是每周都按同一个计划练，额外练习能弥补起步慢。

tip: compensate sb for a loss 是赔偿。compensate for a weakness 是弥补。名词 compensation。

senses.en: to give time or energy to

ex.en: She will devote more time to study.
ex.zh: 她将把更多时间用于学习。

ex.en: Governments should devote more resources to preventive healthcare rather than relying entirely on expensive medical treatments.
ex.zh: 政府应将更多资源投入预防性医疗，而不是完全依赖昂贵的医学治疗。

tip: devote…to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to change to fit a new situation
to change something for a different use or audience

ex.en: Animals must adapt to climate change.
ex.zh: 动物必须适应气候变化。

ex.en: Schools must adapt their teaching methods to meet the needs of students from diverse cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 学校必须调整教学方法，以满足不同文化背景学生的需求。

col: adapt teaching methods｜调整教学方法
adapt a novel for television｜把小说改编成电视剧
tip: adapt to后接名词或动名词；勿混adopt（采用）。

senses.en: a border, or the edge of what is known

ex.en: The town sits on the frontier between two regions.
ex.zh: 小镇坐落在两个地区的边界上。

ex.en: The article calls medical research a new frontier, full of questions we cannot answer yet.
ex.zh: 文章把医学研究称为新的前沿，里面满是我们还答不上的问题。

tip: 地理上是边境。引申义是某领域的前沿，常用 a new frontier。

senses.en: to burst with force, or to increase suddenly

ex.en: A sealed can may explode in a fire.
ex.zh: 密封罐在火里可能爆炸。

ex.en: The number of applications did not explode until the school posted the scholarship date.
ex.zh: 学校公布奖学金日期之后，申请数量才一下子多起来。

tip: 动词 explode，名词 explosion。本卡只讲安全和「突然变多」，不写制造爆炸物的方法。
note: 只收安全常识和「激增」义。

senses.en: easily broken or damaged

ex.en: These glasses are fragile, so pack them well.
ex.zh: 这些玻璃杯易碎，要包好。

ex.en: The fragile pages tore when we turned them, so the librarian brought cotton gloves.
ex.zh: 脆弱的书页一翻就裂，图书管理员便拿来了棉手套。

col: handle with care, fragile｜易碎，小心轻放
tip: 英式 fragile 常读成和 mile 押韵；美式末尾更像 /dʒəl/。意思都是易碎。

senses.en: a list of items, American spelling
to make a list of items

ex.en: The library catalog lists three copies.
ex.zh: 图书馆目录里列着三本。

ex.en: Search the catalog by the writer's family name if you do not know the full title.
ex.zh: 如果不知道完整书名，就按作者的姓在目录里查。

tip: 美式拼作 catalog。本批另有英式 catalogue，两条都能搜到。
note: 美式拼写。英式 catalogue 在本批另列。

senses.en: a person who directs musicians, or who sells tickets on a bus or train
a material that lets heat or electricity pass through

ex.en: The conductor raised the baton.
ex.zh: 指挥举起了指挥棒。

ex.en: Copper is a good conductor, so the lab uses it when the circuit will not close.
ex.zh: 铜是良导体，所以电路合不上时实验室用它。

col: a bus conductor｜公共汽车售票员
tip: conductor 可以是指挥、公共汽车售票员，也可以是物理里的导体。动词是 conduct。

senses.en: a small pack, or a block of data sent together

ex.en: Open one packet of seeds.
ex.zh: 打开一包种子。

ex.en: The lost packet of letters was under the bench, still tied with the red string.
ex.zh: 那包信落在长凳底下，红绳还系着。

col: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干
a packet of data｜一个数据包
tip: 英式小包装常用 packet。美式常用 pack 或 package。数据包也是 packet。

senses.en: previous
being the first of two people or things just mentioned

ex.en: He is a former student of this school.
ex.zh: 他是这所学校以前的学生。

ex.en: Former industrial sites can be transformed into public parks, improving urban environments and creating shared spaces.
ex.zh: 昔日的工业用地可以改建为公园，从而改善城市环境并创造共享空间。

col: former industrial site｜昔日工业用地
tip: the former 指两者中的前者，the latter 指后者。

senses.en: easy to see or understand

ex.en: It is evident that she studied hard.
ex.zh: 很明显她学习很努力。

ex.en: The benefits of improved public transport are evident in cities where traffic congestion has decreased.
ex.zh: 在交通拥堵有所缓解的城市，改善公共交通的益处显而易见。

tip: 常用It is evident that...表示显然……。

senses.en: the main stem of a tree, or a large box

ex.en: We sat on the fallen trunk and ate lunch.
ex.zh: 我们坐在倒下的树干上吃午饭。

ex.en: The old trunk in the attic holds letters, and the lock still works.
ex.zh: 阁楼上的旧箱子里放着信，锁还能用。

tip: 参考表是树干和大箱子。象鼻也叫 trunk，本卡按表先记这两项。
